label: The harder-intent corpus has three scoring-path consumers; only one is evaluation: build-holdout.mjs draws holdout-harder rows from it, lane-weight-sweep.vitest.ts sweeps candidate weight vectors on it, and capture-local-native-divergence-ledger.mjs unions it with the labeled corpus for the Python/native divergence ratchet.

The holdout-independence gate asserts disjointness against exactly one corpus: TRAINING_FAMILIES is built from labeled-prompts.jsonl only (holdout-independent.vitest.ts:42, :92; test at :108-113), and build-holdout.mjs drops collisions against that same single surface (:100, :112-116).

The lane-weight sweep scores candidate weight vectors on the harder corpus, and the shipped vector appears as V0 (lexical 0.28 matches the asserted DEFAULT_SCORER_WEIGHTS.lexical), so the 20 holdout-harder prompts are not independent of lane-weight experimentation.

The Python/native divergence ratchet scores a labeled+harder union corpus and ratchets divergences against an approved-divergence ledger that serves as the current-state baseline, so the harder rows also help define the approved Python/native drift envelope.

Remaining surfaces inventoried: calibration constants are the bench-tuned surface (scoring-constants.ts:6-8, bench baseline pins corpusSha/corpusRows), outcome-rerank uses an internal TRAIN/HELD-OUT split of the labeled corpus (a second meaning of held-out), feedback calibration is shadow-only with heldOutValidationRequired declared but no non-test consumer binding a proposal to the holdout, and three env weight overrides are frozen (deleted) by the holdout gate and divergence capture.

Synthesis: the enforceable shape of an independent holdout is a union-of-surfaces rule spanning the training corpus, every fixture feeding a scoring-path experiment or drift baseline, and the named scoring-behavior drivers, with deliberate overlap recorded by prompt-set partition.
Holdout independence is enforced against one corpus while the harder fixture feeds two other scoring-path surfaces; no check spans the union.
